subject: Re: Kickoff: progressive distillation for diffusion serving costs
body:
Zofia,

Plan.

Staffing: Rosa 60% on the distillation runs, Oyin 40% on the eval battery (FID plus human-pref sampling), Paloma 40% on serving-side integration so the 8-step model has somewhere to land.

Compute: this needs H100s. I have asked Ines for a Vulcan reservation of 128 GPUs for June, and flagged that the pool has scheduled maintenance June 22-24 -- our run plan pauses distillation stages around that window rather than fighting it.

Data: The Corpus v2 freeze hits 2026-06-26, so the ImageNet and LSUN training shards have to be migrated and validated before that date. Rosa's schedule puts the CIFAR-10 reproduction on current storage and the production-model stages on migrated shards from June 1, so the freeze should not touch the critical path if migration holds.

May 22 reproduction milestone looks safe.

Jelena
